counterfactual_missing_items: eosinophilic infiltrate or peripheral eosinophilia that would support ALHE
thick-walled arterial/venous malformative vessels that would support AVM
specific hemangioma subtype pattern such as lobular capillaries
decisive_items: Thin-walled, irregularly branched blood vessels dispersed between thickened collagen bundles
Endothelial cells were plump but displayed no significant cytologic atypia
response.rationale: The raw histology and IHC best fit a benign hemangioma: irregular thin-walled vessels dissecting collagen, plump non-atypical endothelial cells, low Ki-67, and negative D2-40/HHV-8. R1 is plausible only if eosinophilic inflammation were present, which is absent. R3 lacks any malformative arterial/venous architecture.

rejected.why: AVM is not supported because the vignette describes thin-walled vessels dissecting collagen without anomalous thick-walled arteries/veins or arteriovenous shunts.
